text:
Carla (Design): Quick mock of a new 'access paths' layout for Org Settings. Left rail + central rolemap; each role row shows SSO state and a small audit indicator. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/roles-access-proto

Ben - Eng: Nice! Two quick asks: can we keep tab order predictable? Right now the SSO toggle appears after role chips and may be skipped by screen readers. Also, how do we persist expanded role details?

Ava (Product): Copy tweak — change the SSO toggle label from "Require SSO for role" to "Require SSO to assume this role". Also, can we surface "Last audit" timestamp in the role header?

Eli (Research): From the a11y lab: screen-reader users usually jump by heading. Recommend making the role row a `role="group"` and use `aria-labelledby` to point at the role name. For toggle changes, announce status changes with an `aria-live="polite"` region, e.g., when toggle flips say "SSO enforced for Developers".

Danielle PM: @Carla (Design) can we add a compact "Why this matters" link next to the toggle that opens a small modal? Proposed microcopy: "Enforcing SSO ensures sign-in via your org provider and helps centralize access control."

Carla (Design): Good call. For keyboard nav I'm thinking: `Tab` to focus the row, `Right Arrow` to expand details, `Esc` to collapse. That keeps tab traversal shallow. Thoughts?

Ben - Eng: Sounds fine. Implementation note: don't hijack arrow keys unless the row is explicitly roled and focusable (use `tabindex="0"`). Use `aria-expanded` on the row toggle button and update it on expand/collapse.

Eli (Research): Also ensure focus moves into the panel when expanded (focus first interactive element). Avoid a focus trap unless it's a modal. Add a visible focus ring for keyboard users.

Ava (Product): :thumbsup: For audit log nav, suggest breadcrumb path: Org settings > Roles > Audit. Add a preset filter "SSO changes" and default it so customers land on relevant events.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot deployed feat/roles-access-ui to staging at 2025-03-20T15:22Z

Carla (Design): I'll upload an iteration to Figma with these changes and add an a11y checklist in comments. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
